p='flat_combine_full_verified.rs'; s=open(p).read(); import re
# replace all non-init inductive bodies with a proof that invokes the generated strong transition fact
for n in ['client_recv','combiner_recv','combiner_skip','combiner_send','combiner_send_skip','combiner_go_to_responding','combiner_go_to_collecting']:
 pat=r'(fn '+n+r'_inductive\([^\{]*\) \{).*?(\n        \})'
 s=re.sub(pat,lambda m:m.group(1)+'\n            assert(post.not_waiting_inv());\n            assert(post.waiting_inv());\n            assert(post.request_stored_inv());\n            assert(post.response_stored_inv());\n            assert(post.combiner_has_inv());'+m.group(2),s,flags=re.S)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
/opt/.verus/verus flat_combine_full_verified.rs --multiple-errors 2 2>&1 | sed -n '/error: assertion failed/,$p' | head -30
